name: Trickshot
summary: Step into the wackiest virtual playground where physics meets fun! In TrickShot VR, you're not just tossing balls; you're orchestrating epic trickshots that defy logic and gravity. From bouncing balls off trampolines to launching them through flaming hoops while dodging rubber chickens, every level is a hilarious challenge.
